title: Empty Tithe
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Empty Tithe and the helm marks Tithe Outpost. Do: Close on Tithe Outpost. The Tithe Broker sells food at a starving price. The jurisdiction run that brings food mass is the separate route. Finish: come inside Tithe Outpost's shell. Red Keel heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
